lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canada’s much-anticipated summit with the European Union begins today after months of speculation around how a new alliance between the two bodies will take shape, The Canadian Press reports.
Sir Patrick Stewart: Actor who moved effortlessly between Star Trek and Shakespeare, BBC News reports.
Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed will campaign Sunday in Detroit alongside former primary rival Rep, The Canadian Press reports.
B.C. NDP caucus taps Jennifer Whiteside to be new interim leader, CBC News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
